title: Privacy-Preserving Synthetic Data Generation using DP-CTGAN
summary: A research framework that generates privacy-preserving synthetic tabular data by injecting Differential Privacy (DP-SGD via Opacus) into CTGAN, then stress-tests it with membership inference attacks and a combined Privacy-Utility Score across Adult, ILPD, and Pima datasets. It builds its synthesizers directly on SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (with Metadata schema detection) as the vanilla baseline and foundation for the DP-CTGAN variant.
